verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:

Al masanil juntzanh cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etisraelal: Yalnhej mach ex, ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a he kal tz'ak'an junok yuninal silab'il t'a komon Dios skuchan Moloc, a jun chi' yowalil sjulk'enajcham yuj heb' yetchonhab'.
Skotpax wowal t'a jun anima chi', tzin satel t'a skal heb' yetchonhab', yujto ix yixtejb'at in kajnub', ix in spatikaneli, yujto syak' yuninal silab'il t'a jun komon Dios chi'.
Tato a heb' yetchonhab' tonhej syilochi, max sjulk'enejcham jun anima chi' heb',

a in wal ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', t'a yetb'eyum, t'a yuninal yet' t'a masanil heb' kajan yet' t'a yol spat. Ol in satel heb' t'a skal heb' yetchonhab' yet' heb' syak'em sb'a t'a komon Dios Moloc chi' yet'ok.

Tato ay mach sb'at sk'anb'ej sb'a t'a heb' ajb'a'al, ma t'a heb' sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, sk'anab'ajan tas syal heb' chi', ol wak' yowalil t'a jun anima chi', ol in satel t'a skal yetchonhab'.
Junelnhej tzeyak'och he b'a t'a yol in k'ab', wach'nhej tzeyutej he b'a, yujto a in Jehová in tik, he Diosal in.
Ha wal in b'eyb'al tze b'eyb'alej, tze k'anab'ajani, yujto a in Jehová in tzex wak'och wikok.
Yalnhej mach sb'aj smam snun yowalil schami, a wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanima'il, yowalil scham jun winak chi' yet' jun ix ix chi'.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum smam, syak' k'ixwelal smam chi'. Ha jun winak chi' yowalil schami, schampax ix ix chi', a wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yalib', yowalil scham heb' schawanhil, yujto yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' yetwinakil, icha sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix, yowalil scham heb' schawanhil. Ha wal heb' tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh, yujto yajb'entak tas sk'ulej heb' chi'.

Tato ay junok winh winak tz'ik'an junok ix ix, syik'anpaxk'e snun ix ix chi' winh, te chuk tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a jun winh winak chi' yet' chawanh heb' ix ix chi', snhusjitz'a heb'. Yuj chi' manhxa b'aj ol b'inaj jun b'eyb'al chi' t'a he kal.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a winh chi' yowalil scham winh, schampax nok' nok' chi'.
Tato ay pax junok ix ix smulan yet' junok nok' nok', a jun ix chi' yowalil scham ix, schampax jun nok' nok' chi'. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak syik' yanab' yetb'eyumok, yanab' yuj smam ma yanab' yuj snun, a chawanh heb' chi', t'a wal yichanh heb' yetchonhab' heb' satjieli, yujto a mach smulan yet' yanab', yelxo wal k'ixwelal tas sk'ulej heb' chi', yuj chi' a mach icha chi' sk'ulej, a smul chi' skotkan t'a yib'anh.

Tato ay junok winh winak ay tas sk'ulej yet' junok ix ix ayik ayoch ix sb'isan uj, malaj yelk'och t'a yol sat winh tas tz'ik'an ix chi', b'ekanpax sk'ol ix sch'oxanel syahelal chi', yuj chi' manhxaokab' yalan yik heb' schawanhil t'a he kal.
Malajokab' junok winh winak smulan yet' yanab' smam, ma yet' snulej snun, yujto syak' sk'ixwelal winh mach ayto yuj sb'a yet'ok. Ha yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil.

Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak smam ma winh snulej snun, syak' wal k'ixwelal jun yicham chi', a yuj smul heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh schawanhil, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
Tato ay junok winh winak smulan yet' ix yetb'eyum winh yuk'tak, syak' k'ixwelal winh yuk'tak winh chi', a jun chi' yajb'entak, yuj chi' smiljicham heb', malaj yinhtilal heb' skani.
B'eyb'alejek in b'eyb'al, tze k'anab'ajan masanil in cheknab'il tik yik wach' manh ol ex in satel t'a lum lum b'aj ol ex k'och kajan chi'.
Manh he b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' anima ol wik'el t'a eyichanh chi'. Ha heb' chi', sb'eyb'alej masanil juntzanh chukal tik heb', yuj chi' tzin chakel heb'.
Ha in wal ix wak' in ti' to ol wak' eyikejkan slum heb' chi' he makb'enok, lum te yax sat. Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ex in sik'nakelta t'a skal juntzanhxo chonhab'.

Yuj chi' yowalil ay sk'exanhil nok' nok' wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok t'a yol he sat yet' t'a skal nok' much wach' yet' nok' manh wach'ok. Yuj chi' manh he juel he b'a t'a wichanh yuj he chi'an nok' nok' manh wach'ok chi', nok' much, nok' snherwi, ma nok' sjachwi t'a sat lum tik, haton nok' ix wala' to manh wach'ok.
Palta yowalil wach' tzeyutej he b'a t'a wichanh, yujto wach' innhej a in tik. Ha in Jehová in tik ix ex in sik'eli, to ch'ok eyel t'a yichanh juntzanhxo chonhab', yik wach' in chonhab' tzex aji.

Tato ay junok winh winak ma junok ix ix t'a he kal sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak yalani, yowalil sjulk'enajchamok. Ha wal tz'ik'ankot schamel chi' t'a yib'anh, xchi Jehová, xa chi, xchi t'a winhaj Moisés chi'.
